sql: with t as (select right(regexp_replace(coalesce(test_mode_number,''),'\D','','g'), 8) n from public.ai_agent_settings where company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') select c.bot_step, c.bot_data->'ai_materials_sent' as enviados, c.bot_data->>'ai_auto_materials_at' as auto_at, c.bot_data->>'mes' as mes, c.bot_data->>'convidados' as convidados, c.bot_data->>'ai_history_since' as desde, (select count(*) from public.wapi_messages m where m.conversation_id = c.id and m.from_me and m.message_type in ('image','video','document') and m.timestamp > now() - interval '5 hours') as midias_5h, (select count(*) from public.wapi_messages m where m.conversation_id = c.id and m.from_me and m.timestamp > now() - interval '5 hours') as msgs_5h from public.wapi_conversations c, t where c.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' and t.n <> '' and c.remote_jid like '%' || t.n || '@%'
